about: The record capture's recorded runs, moved from runcontrol's known-answers/import.json (recordsStage) when the capture left runcontrol for the integration module: each row is the stage's machine file, ledger and stand-in capture, and what the step started, printed, wrote and returned, as evalpipeline.py's stage_records answered it when the rows were made (known-answers/make_known_answers_import.py, in the history). Read by tests/test_record_capture.py.
